notes: You can now see what the model saw. A photo you send used to go straight from pixels to an in-character reply, so what the model actually made of it was never written down — a reply that misread a picture looked exactly like one that read it perfectly. Before answering, the same vision engine is now asked for a plain description, and it goes in the troubleshooting log under a vision tag with how long it took and which engine read it. The description is also kept on the message, which fixes something else: photos only ride along as pixels for a couple of messages, and after that the character used to see nothing but a note that a photo had been sent. Now it still knows what was in it.
